problem.title: Multi-Threshold Thread Engagement Filter
problem.prompt: A community forum tracks thread participation through individual post events. Management wants to identify threads that meet multiple engagement criteria simultaneously: (1) received at least 5 posts tagged as 'helpful' and (2) received at least 3 posts tagged as 'insightful'. Each post has exactly one tag. Write a query that returns threads meeting BOTH thresholds. Return columns `thread_id` and `thread_title`, ordered by `thread_id` ascending. A thread qualifies only if it has enough posts in each required tag category.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE threads (thread_id INT PRIMARY KEY, thread_title VARCHAR(200)); CREATE TABLE posts (post_id INT PRIMARY KEY, thread_id INT, member_id INT, tag VARCHAR(50));
problem.example_input_data: INSERT INTO threads (thread_id, thread_title) VALUES (101, 'Getting Started with PostgreSQL'), (102, 'Advanced Indexing Strategies'), (103, 'Query Optimization Tips'), (104, 'Database Design Patterns'); INSERT INTO posts (post_id, thread_id, member_id, tag) VALUES (1, 101, 201, 'helpful'), (2, 101, 202, 'helpful'), (3, 101, 203, 'helpful'), (4, 101, 204, 'helpful'), (5, 101, 205, 'helpful'), (6, 101, 206, 'insightful'), (7, 101, 207, 'insightful'), (8, 101, 208, 'insightful'), (9, 102, 209, 'helpful'), (10, 102, 210, 'helpful'), (11, 102, 211, 'insightful'), (12, 102, 212, 'insightful'), (13, 103, 213, 'helpful'), (14, 103, 214, 'helpful'), (15, 103, 215, 'helpful'), (16, 103, 216, 'helpful'), (17, 103, 217, 'helpful'), (18, 103, 218, 'helpful'), (19, 104, 219, 'insightful'), (20, 104, 220, 'insightful'), (21, 104, 221, 'insightful'), (22, 104, 222, 'insightful');

composite_moves: sum conditional counts for each tag threshold
filter groups in HAVING by both thresholds

hints: You need to count posts separately by tag category for each thread.
Use conditional aggregation: SUM(CASE WHEN tag = 'helpful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) and similar for 'insightful'.
Apply both threshold conditions in the HAVING clause after GROUP BY thread_id.
problem.answer_key: SELECT t.thread_id, t.thread_title FROM threads t JOIN posts p ON t.thread_id = p.thread_id GROUP BY t.thread_id, t.thread_title HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.tag = 'helpful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.tag = 'insightful' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY t.thread_id;

_meta.scenario: a community forum tracking thread participation and member retention

user_solution:
/* 

Management wants to identify threads that
- received at least 5 posts tagged as 'helpful' and
- received at least 3 posts tagged as 'insightful'

Write a query that returns threads meeting BOTH thresholds.
Return columns `thread_id` and `thread_title`, ordered by `thread_id` ascending.
A thread qualifies only if it has enough posts in each required tag category.
*/
SELECT
    t.thread_id,
    t.thread_title
FROM threads AS t
JOIN posts AS p
    ON t.thread_id = p.thread_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN tag = 'helpful' THEN 1 END) >= 5 AND
        SUM(CASE WHEN tag = 'insightful' THEN 1 END) >= 3
ORDER BY thread_id;
